Feature: Doctor and Chemist/Lab Management System
  As a healthcare system user
    Background:
      Given the system allows adding, viewing, updating, and deleting Doctor and Chemist/Lab details
      
    # Requirement U12_4: Add a new unique Doctor
    @Nonce(U12_4)
    Scenario: Add a new Doctor with valid details
    Given a new Doctor record is not present
    When I add a new Doctor with Name: "John Doe", Age: 30, Sex: Male, Qualification: MD, Experience: 5 years, Speciality: Cardiology
    Then the Doctor record should be present with the specified details
    
    # Requirement U12_4: View and Update the details of an existing Doctor (Speciality cannot be updated)
    @Nonce(U12_4)
    Scenario: Attempt to update Doctor's Speciality
    Given a Doctor with Speciality: Cardiology already exists
    When I update the Doctor's Speciality to "Neurology"
    Then I should receive an error message stating "Speciality cannot be updated"
    
    # Requirement U12_4: Delete the Doctor Details (Pending Consultation Request)
    @Nonce(U12_4)
    Scenario: Delete Doctor with pending Consultation Request
    Given a Doctor exists with a pending Consultation Request
    And a new Patient Consultation Request is created
    When I attempt to delete the Doctor
    Then I should receive an error message stating "Deletion not allowed due to pending Consultation Request"
    
    # Requirement U12_4: Maintain Chemist & Labs
    @Nonce(U12_4)
    Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given no Chemist or Lab exists in a specific Pincode
    When I add a new Chemist or Lab with valid details
    Then the Chemist or Lab record should be present with the specified details
    
    # Requirement U12_4: View and Update the details of an existing Chemist/Lab (Pincode cannot be updated)
    @Nonce(U12_4)
    Scenario: Update Chemist/Lab details with invalid Pincode
    Given a Chemist/Lab exists with a valid Pincode
    And I update the Pincode to an invalid one
    When I attempt to update the details
    Then I should receive an error message stating "Pincode cannot be updated"
    
    # Requirement U12_4: Delete the Chemist/Lab Details (Pending Prescription)
    @Nonce(U12_4)
    Scenario: Delete Chemist/Lab with pending Prescription
    Given a Chemist/Lab exists with a valid Pincode
    And a new Prescription is created
    When I attempt to delete the Chemist/Lab
    Then I should receive an error message stating "Deletion not allowed due to pending Prescription"

test_cases.title: Delete Chemist/Lab with pending Prescription (should fail)

Feature: Doctor, Chemist, and Lab Management

  Background:
    As a backend system handling medical records
    As an integral part of the healthcare management software
    I want to ensure the integrity and proper handling of doctor, chemist, and lab data

  Scenario: Add a new unique Doctor
    Given a new doctor registration form is presented
    When the user submits the form with Name, Age, Sex, Qualification, and Experience
    Then the system should create a new doctor record
    And the doctor's details should be retrievable

  Scenario: Ensure Doctor' extraneous details cannot be updated
    Given a doctor's details are already registered
    When the user attempts to update the Speciality
    Then the system should reject the update

  Scenario: Delete a Doctor's details
    Given a doctor's details are registered and no pending Patient Consultation Request
    When the user requests to delete the doctor
    Then the system should remove the doctor's details
    And confirm the deletion

  Scenario: Maintain Chemist & Lab Details

    Background:
      As a backend system handling medical records
      As an integral part of the healthcare management software
      I want to ensure the integrity and proper handling of chemist and lab data

    Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
      Given a request to add a new Chemist or Lab
      When the user submits the form with required details
      Then the system should create a new Chemist or Lab record
      And ensure there is only one Chemist or Lab per Pincode

    Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details
      Given a Chemist/Lab record is displayed
      When the user submits updates to the details
      Then the system should update the Chemist/Lab record
      And ensure the Pincode for the Chemist/Lab remains unchanged

    Scenario: Delete a Chemist/Lab Details
      Given a Chemist/Lab record is registered and no pending Prescription
      When the user requests to delete the Chemist/Lab
      Then the system should remove the Chemist/Lab record
      And confirm the deletion

      | Lab         | Update Error                    |

    When attempting to delete the Chemist or Lab
